## Initial Full Regression Model

TODO: justify predictors.

```{r full-fit}
fit <- lm(demand ~ price + discount + promotion + competitor_pricing + epidemic +
            category + region + seasonality + weather_condition,
          data = dat)
reg_table(fit, caption = "Initial full model: OLS coefficient estimates")
```

```{r full-glance}
glance(fit) |>
  select(r.squared, adj.r.squared, sigma, statistic, p.value, AIC, BIC) |>
  kable(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, caption = "Initial full model: fit statistics") |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position")
```
